t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes come in two groups of colours. One group scores low and the other high. Once you find the high scoring colour you should stick with it. If both low, alternate until you find the higher scoring colour again.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are divided into two groups based on colour; darker and lighter colours. Test the different colours, when you find one colour that is giving larger rewards stick with that colour group. The pattern may alternate through the rounds so you will need to swap colours if that one is no longer giving the larger rewards.
